summary: Iteration 3 (multi-item cart, Gemini UCP+AP2 journey, compare screen, Spending Insights). Backend: 48/48 pytest pass (19 new in test_multi_cart_insights.py + 29 updated legacy regression tests). Frontend (390x844 web preview): Gemini journey E2E passed (header 'Gemini · UCP + AP2', chat-agent-name Gemini, suggestion -> 3 product-add buttons, cart widget +/- and subtotal, 'Buy with Gemini', review-line rows, tip-chip-6.5 PATCH $95.22 -> $96.72, back to chat + qty change re-PATCHes the same session, FaceID -> Authorize shows Protocol 'UCP + AP2', 'Pay Target', confirmed with TGT- order and all line items). Gemini protocol panel titles verified: Discovery & Intent Mandate / UCP checkout session / User presence proof / Cart & Payment Mandates / Complete UCP checkout / Order confirmed. LLM [[add:id:qty]] tag auto-populates the cart (e.g. 'Add 6-pack of socks', 'Add 1 black sandals and 2 swim shorts'). ChatGPT journey regression: approve (IC- order, 'Pay Instacart') and decline (Purchase declined, step DECLINED, 'Session canceled') pass; qty max 10 enforced (increase disabled), trash at qty 1 removes item. Compare screen: 6 compare-row-* and 2 compare-try-* buttons, try-chatgpt routes to /journey?agent=chatgpt. Agent Activity: insights total/purchases/declined/points correct; prev/next month nav works (Oct seeded 4 purchases, Sep 2 + 1 declined), next disabled at current month; new purchase (+$49.61, +248 pts) and decline reflected. Only minor issues found.

minor.issue: Month format check accepts invalid months like 2026-13 and 2026-00 (returns 200 with empty data instead of 422). Use datetime.strptime(month, '%Y-%m').
Unknown top-level fields are silently ignored (e.g. a stray top-level 'quantity'); consider model_config extra='forbid' for stricter ACP contract validation.

ui_bugs.issue: Errors from POST/PATCH checkout_sessions are stored in `error` state, but that state is not passed to ChatStep or PaymentStep, so a failed checkout or tip change fails silently. The stale error is then shown on AuthorizeStep (which does receive `error`) before the user makes any decision.
When the month changes, the previous month's data stays on screen under the new month label until the fetch resolves, because `data` is not reset and there is no loading state on offset change.

integration_issues.issue: The client builds the YYYY-MM key from local time (new Date()), but the server groups by UTC created_at. Near month boundaries a user's purchase can land in the 'wrong' month, and the 'current month' can differ from the server's.

issues: product-add-* buttons (height 36) and tip-chip-* (height 36) have no hitSlop, so they are below the 44pt minimum touch target (cart +/- use hitSlop=4, which is OK).

The ACP 'Product discovery' card is tagged ['UCP','ACP'] and shows endpoint 'POST /ucp/v1/catalog/search' (src/protocols.ts:203,212). This contradicts the compare screen, which describes ACP discovery as a merchant product feed and UCP as Gemini-only. Use ACP-only tags and an ACP feed endpoint.

action_items: Pass the journey `error` to ChatStep (checkout) and PaymentStep (tip) and render it; clear `error` on step change so stale errors don't appear on AuthorizeStep.
Fix the ACP step-0 protocol info in src/protocols.ts (lines ~203/212): remove the UCP tag and the /ucp endpoint for the ChatGPT journey.
Validate insights month with datetime.strptime('%Y-%m') to return 422 for 2026-13 and 2026-00.
Optional: reset InsightsCard data / show a loader on month change; add hitSlop or 44pt height to product-add-* and tip-chip-*; consider computing the month in UTC on the client to match the server.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 511 lines: OK. _id is excluded everywhere. Pydantic validation is in place (qty 1-10, items 1-10, tip 0-100).
PATCH correctly locks after authorization (400). Authorize is idempotent per session. Order prefix TGT for gemini, IC for chatgpt.

No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch) found. The safe area comes from react-native-safe-area-context insets. KeyboardAvoidingView is from react-native-keyboard-controller.
Pressables on web need roughly 1.5s of hydration time before a click registers in Playwright (force-click immediately after load did nothing). This is a test-timing note, not an app bug.
